list.title: Data import
list.description: CSV / XLSX / JSON files are parsed in your browser and written to the object graph in batches; the raw file is never uploaded.
list.emptyHint: Import a supplier or material file to start building your object graph.

source.title: Choose a source
source.onlyFile: Community Edition supports file import only: files are parsed in the browser and never uploaded.

xlsx.title: Excel (XLSX)
xlsx.desc: First sheet, cell values only; no formulas or macros run

json.title: JSON
json.desc: An array of objects, or one under items / data / records / rows

source.targetHint: Each row becomes one object of this type (merged by primary key).

upload.title: Upload file
upload.notice: The file is parsed in your browser only — the raw file is never uploaded; only mapped rows are submitted.
upload.parsed: Parsed {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {cols, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}
upload.truncated: The file has more than {max, number} rows; only the first {max, number} were read.

errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the {mb} MB limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Unsupported format — use CSV, XLSX or JSON.
errors.EMPTY_FILE: The file has no data rows.
errors.INVALID_JSON: Invalid JSON: expected an array of objects (or one under items / data / records / rows).
errors.PARSE_FAILED: The file could not be parsed.

mapping.title: Field mapping → target type
mapping.aiNote: Deterministic matching (same name, synonyms, similarity) runs first; only unmatched fields go to the AI, and every AI suggestion must be confirmed.
mapping.aiRules: Today's AI mapping drafts are used up: only deterministic matching was applied; the AI was not used.
mapping.aiApplied: AI draft applied: {count, plural, =0 {no new AI suggestions} one {# AI suggestion needs confirmation} other {# AI suggestions need confirmation}}.
mapping.noRowsLeft: No import rows left today; an import job cannot be created.

problems.PRIMARY_KEY_UNMAPPED: Map a source field to the primary key {prop}.
problems.DUPLICATE_TARGET: Property {prop} is mapped more than once.
problems.CHAIN_INVALID: The transform chain of {source} is invalid.
problems.AI_UNCONFIRMED: {count, plural, one {# AI suggestion} other {# AI suggestions}} still to confirm.

validate.title: Validate
validate.checks: Each row is checked for required values, types, primary-key conflicts and limits.

overLimitReason.importRows: Over limit: {left} import rows left today
overLimitReason.objects: Over limit: room for {left} more objects
overLimitReason.batchMax: Over limit: at most {left} rows per day
overLimitReason.links: Over limit: room for {left} more links

validate.rejectedNote: Rejected rows are still submitted and count toward today's import rows; the server reports the same reasons.

run.planLine: Parsed in browser → {batches, plural, one {# batch} other {# batches}} × {rows} rows (raw file not uploaded)
run.overLimit: {count, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} over the limit, marked and not submitted.
run.nothing: No import quota left today; nothing can be submitted.
run.rowTooLarge: Row {row} exceeds the 512 KB request limit.

job.title: Import job
job.rejectsHint: Row, column and error type only — never cell values (first 200).
